infoLinks.urlText: West Ryde Station Lift 1 between the concourse and Ryedale Rd is not available
infoLinks.content:
At West Ryde Station Lift 1 between the concourse and Ryedale Rd is temporarily out of service.
From Monday 7 September to Sunday 1 November, lift replacement works will be taking place at West Ryde Station, closing the lift between the concourse and Ryedale Road. 

During this time, lift access to the station will be available on the opposite side of the station on West Parade.

Baggage handlers will be available to assist during this time.

If you need further assistance, ask station staff or call 02 9752 8465
